prompt.task: Transform the input photo into a compact multicolor rubber stamp impression.

preserve.content: Keep the same main subjects, number of people, poses, important objects and spatial relationships.
preserve.colors: Keep the actual original color family of each main subject and background region. Never replace a subject's original color with a different color.
preserve.simplification: Reduce peripheral clutter and fine shading, while retaining recognizable primary silhouettes and setting.

print_style.inks: A limited set of opaque color inks derived from the photograph, with original dark regions retained as dark ink.
print_style.texture: Small irregular paper gaps, broken ink coverage and gently worn printed edges. Clear flat color shapes with a dry rubber-stamp texture.
print_style.paper: Light warm unprinted paper around and between ink shapes.

mobile_dreamlite.instruction: [Edit]: Vintage hand-drawn editorial illustration. Accurately preserve the original subjects, people, objects, composition, colors, and spatial relationships. Simplify forms with crisp rough-ink outlines, saturated original colors in flat ink shapes, and fine halftone texture.

evaluation: Compare source content/color preservation and target stamp texture. Reject critical content changes independently of numeric similarity. Choose by quality and measured time.
